VALIDATION_FAILED: Some details need fixing. Check the marked fields and try again.
UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
INVALID_CREDENTIALS: That email or password is not right. Try again.
TOKEN_REUSED: This session is no longer safe. Sign in again.
FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do that.
BOOKING_TOKEN_INVALID: This booking could not be opened. Check the link or look the booking up with its code.
NOT_FOUND: We could not find what you asked for.
EMAIL_TAKEN: That email already has an account. Sign in or use a different email.
SEAT_UNAVAILABLE: Someone just took the seat you chose. Pick another seat.
SHOWTIME_OVERLAP: That showtime overlaps another one in the room. Choose a different time.
INVALID_STATE: That action is not available for this booking right now.
RESOURCE_IN_USE: This item is in use, so it cannot be deleted or changed yet.
HOLD_EXPIRED: The seat hold has expired. Choose your seats again.
ORPHAN_SEAT: This selection would leave a single seat empty on its own. Add or change a seat.
TICKET_COUNT_MISMATCH: The number of seats does not match the number of tickets. Adjust them so they match.
BOOKING_TOO_LARGE: This booking has more tickets than allowed. Remove some tickets.
SALES_CLOSED: Ticket sales for this showtime are closed.
NOT_BOOKABLE: This showtime is not on sale yet.
CUSTOMER_INFO_REQUIRED: Enter your name, phone number and email before paying.
SEED_PROTECTED: Seed data is protected in the demo and restored nightly.
RATE_LIMITED: That was too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
SEAT_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: Seat selection is temporarily unavailable, please try again in a moment.
INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
